entities.summary: Natan Yakovlevich Eidelman was a Soviet Russian author and historian who was born and died in Moscow, who wrote several books on about the life and work of Alexander Pushkin, Decembrists Sergey Muravyov-Apostol and Mikhail Lunin, and historian Nikolai Mikhailovich Karamzin. He is the father of Tamara Eidelman.
